ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest1.desc: &7The &bQuantum Computer&7 is a special type of crafting computer designed to handle an &eunlimited number of crafting requests&7—as long as it has enough &bcrafting storage&7 available.
&bQuantum Data Entangler&7: Multiplies the storage of all storage blocks in the multiblock by &b4x&7, and only &eone&7 can be placed.
&bQuantum Multi-threader&7: Multiplies total co-processing power by &b4x&7, and only &eone&7 can be placed.
&7The Quantum Computer multiblock can scale up to &b7x7x7&7 (external dimensions).
&7The outside layer must be &bQuantum Structure&7 blocks, and &eQuantum Structure cannot be placed inside&7 the multiblock.
&7The interior must contain &eno empty spaces&7 (you can fill extra space with &bQuantum Unit&7 blocks for no additional benefit).
&7Place &eexactly one&7 &bQuantum Core&7, and at most &eone&7 &bData Entangler&7 and at most &eone&7 &bMulti-threader&7.
&7The &bQuantum Core&7 is the heart of the system: it works standalone and provides &b256M crafting storage&7 plus &b8 co-processors&7 on its own.
&7When used standalone, power must be provided through the &eUp or Down&7 sides (where the connectors are).
&7Use &bQuantum Storage&7 blocks to increase the available crafting storage and therefore improve how many concurrent tasks the computer can handle.
&bQuantum Accelerator&7: Adds &b8 co-processors&7 to the multiblock, and all crafting tasks can share the available co-processors—so stacking accelerators is very effective.
ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest10.des: The &2Neo ECO AE Extension&r adds three powerful multiblock systems that massively expand your AE2 capabilities.
The &2Storage System &rprovides huge ME storage with ECO cells up to 256MB, integrated high-density energy storage, and three tiers: &bL4&r, &6L6&r, and &5L9&r.
The &2Computation System &rreplaces vanilla crafting CPUs with a scalable cluster that supports many parallel crafting threads and massive acceleration across &bC4&r, &6C6&r, and &5C9&r tiers.
The &2Crafting System &racts as an advanced pattern provider with high parallelism, overclocking, active cooling, and three performance tiers: &bF4&r, &6F6&r, and &5F9&r.
All multiblocks can be built manually or with the &2Structure Terminal&r, which shows a preview, checks materials, and places missing blocks automatically.
The &aEnergized Budding Crystal &ris a key material for many components and can be obtained via lightning strikes.
The &aIntegrated Working Station &rcombines multiple AE2 device functions and is essential for crafting advanced components and multiblock controllers.
Higher tiers (&b4&r → &66&r → &59&r) give more capacity, speed, and efficiency, but require rarer materials and more power.
ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest13.des: The &3Infinity Cells&r provide infinite amounts of basic resources directly in your ME system.
The &3Infinity Water Cell &rgives unlimited water, and the &3Infinity Cobblestone Cell &rgives unlimited cobblestone, removing the need for external generators.
ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest14.des: The &3Extended Import Bus &rand &3Extended Export Bus&r offer higher throughput and more upgrade slots than vanilla AE2 buses.
They operate &38× faster &rby default and support &38 upgrade slots&r instead of 5, allowing more acceleration, capacity, and control cards.
ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest15.des: The &3ME Extended Pattern Access Terminal &rprovides a searchable overview of all pattern providers on your ME network.
It shows patterns with their inputs and outputs, lets you filter by item or fluid, and can highlight the actual pattern provider block in the world.
ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest16.des: The &3ME Wireless Hub &racts as a central hub that can connect up to 8 wireless connectors or hubs, distributing up to 32 channels total.
Both require the &3ME Wireless Setup Kit &rto bind connections and only work within a single dimension.
The &3ME Wireless Connector &rcreates a wireless link between two points in the same dimension, transmitting up to 32 channels without cables.
ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest17.des: The &3ME Ingredient Buffer &rstores items and fluids in one block and can be paired with a Pattern Provider to automate complex recipes.
This setup allows you to automate multiblocks like the &5Antimatter Protomolecular Transmutator (APT) &rand the &5Fire Attuned Multiblock&r by buffering all required ingredients in one place.
ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest18.des: The &3Circuit Slicer &rconverts whole blocks directly into printed circuits without needing inscriber presses.
It processes materials like gold, diamond, silicon, and entro blocks into multiple circuit prints at once, making it much faster than vanilla inscribers.
ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest19.des: The &3ME Oversized Interface &rextends the vanilla interface with more slots and higher stack limits.
It offers 4 rows of slots (32 total) and supports stack sizes up to 1024, making it ideal for high-throughput item and fluid buffering.
Use it to keep large ingredient buffers for multiblocks or machines that consume resources faster than a normal interface can supply.
ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest2.desc: This tab gathers the &bmost important&r AE2 addons for advanced automation, storage, and crafting.
Use it as a &dquick reference&r for what each mod adds and how they &aenhance&r your &9ME Network&r.
Special focus lies on &5&lmultiblocks&r that define the late-game AE2 experience.
ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest20.des: The &3Extended Inscriber &rcombines four inscriber operations into a single block, running up to four jobs simultaneously.
It has four separate job pages, each with its own press and input slots, allowing you to produce different circuits or processors in one machine.
This makes it ideal for compact processor factories, though for late-game circuits the &3Circuit Slicer &rand &3Crystal Assembler &rare often faster alternatives.
ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest21.des: The &5Wireless Transceiver &rcreates a wireless ME channel link that works across any distance and even across dimensions.
Place one transceiver on your main ME Controller and another at your remote base, then set both to the same channel frequency to link them.
Unlike the ME Wireless Connector, the &5Wireless Transceiver &rdoes not require a setup kit and supports full cross-dimension networks.
The chunk containing the main transceiver must be chunk-loaded for the connection to remain active.
ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest22.des: The &5Mirror Pattern Provider &rlets you mirror the patterns of other Pattern Providers or Extended Pattern Providers using the &5Mirror Binding Tool&r.
Once linked, it acts as a remote copy of the original provider's patterns, allowing you to distribute crafting logic across your base without re-encoding everything.
&4Sidenote&r: Don't place too many Mirror Pattern Providers, as they can become laggy when overused.
ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest23.des: The &54x, 16x, 64x, 256x, and 1024x Crafting Accelerators&r are multiblock components that massively increase the crafting speed of your AE2 Crafting CPUs.
Place them inside a Crafting CPU multiblock alongside Crafting Storage and Co-Processors to reduce the time required for complex or large-scale autocrafting jobs.
Higher-tier accelerators provide exponentially faster crafting, but also consume significantly more power per tick.
Use them to push your autocrafting system far beyond vanilla AE2 limits, especially when combined with high-speed machines and pattern providers.

ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest32.des: # OmniSequence
- Matter deconstruction and rewriting similar to transmutation, with configurable rules.
- Cross-dimensional network links via &b&lAE2 Quantum Rings&r.
- Strong spawn protection around formed multiblocks.
## Why use it
Use OmniSequence when standard &b&lAE2&r autocrafting hits limits in throughput, complexity, or scale.
It is designed for late-game bases that need:
- Massive, stable &b&lautocrafting&r for complex modpack recipes.
- Efficient conversion of bulk resources into high-value components.
- Centralized, research-driven progression that gates powerful machines behind clear milestones.
- Compact, high-performance crafting that reduces the need for thousands of individual pattern providers and machines.
&3&lOmniSequence&r is an end-game automation mod built on &b&lAE2&r.
## When you need it
You will benefit from OmniSequence once you:
- Run large &b&lME Networks&r with heavy crafting demand.
- Want to automate expensive, multi-step recipes without exploding lag or block counts.
- Plan cross-dimensional production or remote crafting hubs.
- Aim for a clean, scalable end-game automation layer instead of ad-hoc machine rooms.
In short: OmniSequence turns your &b&lAE2&r network into a true industrial fabricator, combining research, computation, and matter rewriting into one cohesive end-game system.
It adds high-throughput crafting CPUs, molecular sequence rewriting, and large-scale computation to turn massive resource flows into reliable, scalable production.
## What it does
The mod introduces the &2&lMatter Fabrication Well&r as the central research and processing hub.

From there, you unlock two main branches: the &3&lSequence Array&r for molecular rewriting and parallel crafting, and the &d&lOmni-Computation&r branch for effectively unlimited logical crafting storage and parallelism via the &3&lOmni-Computation Core&r.
Key features include:
- Virtual parallel crafting with extremely high logical CPU capacity.
- Internal pattern libraries and dedicated auto-crafting slots.
ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest33.des: The &dUltimate Super Assembler Matrix Builder &ris a special tool from &2Extended AE Plus &rthat places and instantly forms the complete &dUltimate Super Assembler &rmultiblock structure.
All internal positions must be filled with &6Super Assembler Matrix Hybrid Cores&r; original ExtendedAE matrix cores cannot be used in this structure.

Each &6Hybrid Core &rcombines the effects of a Pattern Core, Crafting Core, and Speed Core: it provides &b72 pattern slots&r, &b512 crafting jobs&r, and the speed bonus of &bfive regular Speed Cores&r.
Only AE2 molecular-assembler compatible crafting patterns can be inserted into the matrix; other pattern types are not supported.

For endgame bases, the &dUltimate Super Assembler Matrix &ris a fixed &b14×16×14 &rstructure with 312 Hybrid Cores and 4 Upload Cores, offering &b22,464 pattern slots &rand effectively unlimited parallel crafting capacity.
After you select an origin by right-clicking a block face, the builder shows a &bpreview &rof the entire matrix; hold &bCtrl &rwhile previewing to see the individual structure parts.
You can change the origin at any time by sneak-right-clicking another block, or cancel the selection by sneak-right-clicking air.
When you right-click with an origin selected, the builder checks every required block position first; it will not overwrite existing blocks, and a failed placement leaves the world unchanged.
You must first bind the builder to an &3ME Interface &rby sneak-right-clicking it; the tool then simulates the full material cost in that ME network before building.
If all required items are available, the builder extracts them and places the complete multiblock; if not, the chat lists every missing item and amount, and no materials are consumed.
The &6Super Assembler Matrix &ris a powerful multiblock crafting provider for &2AE2 &rthat integrates directly into your normal autocrafting system.
Once formed, you connect any active matrix block to your &3ME Network&r and can then use its stored crafting patterns through the standard AE2 autocrafting interface.

The structure is built as a sealed cuboid between &b3×3×3 &rand &b9×9×9 &rblocks, with &6Matrix Frames &ron every outer edge and &6Matrix Walls &r(or compatible glass) on the remaining outer surfaces.
ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest34.des: The &6Super Circuit Cutter &ris an advanced machine from &2Extended AE Plus &rthat processes circuit-cutter recipes with up to &b8 parallels &rin a single cycle.
It works like a normal circuit cutter, but instead of one recipe at a time, it can run up to &b8 copies &rof the same recipe simultaneously, as long as it has enough items, fluid, and output space.
To use it, insert the required &3item &rand &9fluid &rinto the machine; it will automatically choose how many parallels (1–8) it can run based on available inputs and AE power.
Each parallel operation consumes its own share of &6AE, items, and fluid&r, and all outputs are combined into the machine’s output slot.
If the output slot cannot hold a full batch, the machine automatically reduces the number of parallels instead of wasting resources.
The &6Super Circuit Cutter &rhas an internal buffer of &b64,000 AE &rand supports up to &b4 AE2 Speed Cards&r, which reduce processing time but do not increase the 8-recipe parallel limit.
Enable &aAuto-Export &rin the machine interface to automatically send finished circuits to adjacent inventories for easier integration into your production lines.

ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest41.des: # Sequence Array Controller
New patterns start &c&ldisabled&r.
Each logical input has an independent &b&lME reserve&r: passive crafting never extracts enough of that ingredient or any valid substitute to drop its stock below the reserve.
The primary output has an &b&lME stock limit&r; `0` disables that limit and continues until protected ingredients or &b&lAE power&r run out.
Conditions are re-checked automatically, so a paused pattern resumes when stock, power, or output capacity returns.
Passive batches pull directly from this controller's &b&lME Network&r and use the `Long.MAX_VALUE` aggregate execution path without acceleration cards.
Primary outputs, byproducts, containers, reusable ingredients, and rollback refunds return exclusively to &b&lME&r through persistent escrow.
There is no internal-storage or adjacent-inventory output mode.
### Reusable inputs and cancellation
The array can run same-key remainders, including &e&lunbreakable items&r, as one persistent reusable batch.

Finite-durability tools are batched only when every craft deterministically adds exactly one damage; &e&lUnbreaking&r-enchanted or otherwise random and context-dependent tools fall back to &b&lAE2&r's original one-craft path.
The &3&lSequence Array Controller&r builds a &3&lSequence Array&r on a &e&l61×61&r footprint and &e&l29 blocks&r tall.
Key-changing remainders such as &9&lwater buckets&r also remain on that path.
Accepted reusable batches survive saves, chunk unloads, and server restarts.
Canceling the &b&lAE2&r crafting job persistently stops all remaining executions and refunds the exact unused materials plus the reusable item's current state.
Completed outputs remain valid, and canceled work cannot resume after reload.
Batch energy uses &b&lAE2&r's native pattern-power calculation over the actual combined inputs.
## Matter sequence rewriting

The matter-rewriting system works like item transmutation in &d&lEquivalent Exchange&r: supported items are deconstructed into stored sequence, and that sequence is then spent to reproduce other supported items.
&2&lMetal&r, &2&lmineral&r, &b&lcrystal&r, and &a&lorganic sequence&r are stored separately.
Deconstruction yields and rewriting costs are different values, so an item is not necessarily reproduced for the same amount recovered from deconstructing it.
### Rewriting
The active layout is the baseless &d&lFrost Feather Crown&r with a central controller.
Place one real item in the &d&lBlueprint Sample&r slot and start rewriting.
The array spends that item's configured sequence cost to create copies.
The sample itself is never consumed, but it must stay in the slot unchanged for the entire job; removing or replacing it stops the job.
Rewritten items can return directly to the &b&lME Network&r or enter the controller's output slot.
A target of `0` runs continuously.
If stored sequence or &b&lME power&r is temporarily insufficient, the job waits and retries.
A changed blueprint or blocked output stops it.
Up to &e&l4 AE2 acceleration cards&r affect batch size, batch interval, and entropy cooling for both operations.
Modpacks may configure each value; defaults are:
### Rewrite entropy
When complete, it merges massive parallel &b&lAE crafting&r, per-pattern passive auto crafting, &a&lmatter sequence rewriting&r, and an optional cross-dimensional &9&lquantum link&r.
Rewrite entropy is a heat-like throughput limit for matter deconstruction and rewriting; it does not affect normal autocrafting.
Every successful operation adds entropy based on the total sequence handled:
- Deconstruction adds at least &e&l1 entropy&r, or the total recovered sequence divided by &e&l64&r.
- Rewriting adds at least &e&l1 entropy&r, or the total sequence cost divided by &e&l16&r.
Default entropy capacity is &e&l1,000,000&r.
Base cooling is &e&l25 per second&r, multiplied by the installed cards' cooling multiplier; &e&l4 cards&r therefore remove &e&l1,600 per second&r by default.
Capacity, base cooling, and multipliers are configurable.
Insufficient free entropy capacity pauses work in &5&lCooling&r until it can resume.
If a single operation costs more entropy than total capacity, waiting cannot solve it: change the target or configuration.
Cards do not change entropy per item; the net accumulation depends on processing throughput and cooling together.
## Autocrafting
## Quantum link and visual settings
The quantum slot accepts one half of a paired entangled singularity.
Place the other half in a powered &b&lAE2 Quantum Ring&r to connect the array across dimensions.
Before the structure is formed, this remote link can only retrieve construction materials.
A full link consumes an additional &e&l512 AE/t&r and &e&l1 channel&r.
The colors tab changes the energy field, core, rings, and crystal effects.
These settings are visual only and do not affect processing speed.
## Natural spawning protection
While formed, constructing, dismantling, or updating its structure, the array blocks natural spawning in all occupied chunks from bedrock to build height.
This includes &c&lmonsters&r, &e&lanimals&r, &b&laquatic mobs&r, and &7&lbats&r, plus &c&lpatrol&r and &c&lreinforcement spawns&r.
The completed array supports virtual parallelism up to the signed 64-bit limit.
&6&lSpawners&r, &e&lspawn eggs&r, &d&lbreeding&r, &b&lcommands&r, and already-existing mobs are not affected.
This protection works without &b&lAE power&r; if no structure or operation owns a chunk, spawning returns to normal there.
Actual throughput still depends on &e&lingredients&r, &b&lenergy&r, &6&loutput capacity&r, and server tick time.
The &d&lAuto Crafting&r tab provides its own row of &e&l9 dedicated pattern slots&r and never pulls patterns from the large library.
Place patterns directly into these slots, then click the numbered selector or right-click the slot to configure it.
ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest42.des: # Matter Fabrication Well
## Processing and research
A new controller starts at &e&lstage 0&r.
The &2&lfirst research&r unlocks &b&lAE material processing&r, materials used by later research, and the &6&lPattern Assembly&r recipe.
&2&lStage two&r has separate &3&lSequence Array&r and &d&lOmni-Computation&r branches.
By default, one completion of &2&lstage one&r is sufficient; both branches may run together.
For ordinary processing, supply the appropriate item/fluid input ports and provide output ports for the results.
For &b&lAE autocrafting&r, insert matching processing patterns into a &6&lPattern Assembly&r.
JEI and guide recipe panels show the research that unlocks each processing recipe.
Research permissions and bonuses belong to this controller.
## Operation and persistence
The &3&lMatter Fabrication Well&r combines material processing, &b&lAE autocrafting&r and research.
Production displays rotating star rings, converging material streams, and manufacturing scan layers.
Independent research constellations appear above them, including simultaneous branches.
Paused, prerequisite-blocked, offline, or unpowered research stops sending light pulses.
Custom stages receive an automatic visual preset.
Only the current well blueprint is retained; experimental development layouts are no longer recognized.
The controller force-loads the required chunks while formed or during construction and dismantling.
Tickets are released when no valid structure or operation needs them.
Chunk loading does not supply materials or energy.
It starts this mod's progression: craft its controller, structural blocks and ports with base &b&lAE2&r materials, then research advanced materials and machines.
The &6&lPattern Assembly&r is produced in the well after the first research unlock.
## Natural spawning protection

While formed, constructing, dismantling, or updating its structure, this multiblock blocks natural spawning throughout the full height of its occupied chunks, including &c&lmonsters&r, &e&lanimals&r, &b&laquatic mobs&r, and &7&lbats&r.
&c&lPatrol&r and &c&lreinforcement spawns&r are also blocked.
&6&lSpawners&r, &e&lspawn eggs&r, &d&lbreeding&r, &b&lcommands&r, and existing mobs are unaffected.
Protection does not require &b&lAE power&r; when no structure or operation owns a chunk, spawning there returns to normal.
ftbquests.chapter.ae2_addons.quest43.des: # Omni-Computation Core
A successful plan does not remove material or power requirements.
Dispatch adapts to machine acceptance and server load.
&6&lIngredients&r, &b&lenergy&r, &c&lbackpressure&r, and server tick time still limit actual throughput.
## Persistence and remote access
The core force-loads required chunks while formed and during construction, dismantling, or structure updates.
Normal controller drops retain stored contents, active jobs, and quantum-slot contents.
Restore the structure and network after replacing it.
If part of the structure is broken or unloaded, active jobs, stored ingredients, and progress are preserved.
Work resumes after the complete structure is loaded and valid again.
The quantum slot accepts one half of a paired entangled singularity.
The &3&lOmni-Computation Core&r is a floating &e&l65×65×35&r end-game &b&lcrafting CPU&r.
Place the other half in a powered &b&lAE2 Quantum Ring&r to connect the core across dimensions.
The quantum link consumes an additional &e&l512 AE/t&r and &e&l1 channel&r.
A wired connection and a conflicting remote network cannot be used at the same time.
When formed and online, it provides effectively unlimited logical crafting storage and parallelism.
Its controller and components are produced in the &2&lMatter Fabrication Well&r after the first completion of &2&lStage II: Omni-Computation&r research.
Defaults require one stage-one completion and &e&l30 seconds&r per stage-two round.
## Autocrafting
The core creates virtual CPU lanes and keeps an idle lane available.
Once formed and online, crafting requests on its network can use the accelerated planner when its normal conditions are met.
Cyclic crafting still needs a valid starting seed and all other ingredients.

• LP powers your rituals and creations via the Blood Altar.
• More advanced altars unlock greater magical power.
Blood Magic adds:
• Daggers and sacrificial tools
• Magical sigils with special abilities
• Alchemical items
• Unique progression items like Tartaric Gems
• Blood Magic offers &apowerful&r effects unavailable
through normal means.

It is an arcane art practiced by mages seeking forbidden power, but every action has a cost. Be warned: blood magic can be deadly if used carelessly.
can cost your health if mismanaged.

Blood Magic works great with tech and automation mods. You can automate your Life Essence production or use it with machinery and other magical mods to deepen your gameplay.
Blood Magic revolves around collecting &cLife Essence&r (by harming yourself or mobs) and using it to power:
• Blood Altars
• Rituals
• Magical tools and sigils
• Powerful armor and effects

or killing mobs with special tools.

The &4Weak Activation Crystals&r is what we'll use after we've assembled the multiblock to actually start the ritual.
In order for the ritual to activate, you'll need a certain amount of blood in your own network. (obtained by placing your blood orb in the altar)
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest26.de: The &5Edge of the Hidden Realm&r ritual takes you to a dungeon consisting of 4 doors that you can open.
In this dungeon you can find &6Saturated Tau&r which is what we'll be using to make the blood stones for the next tier of the blood altar
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest27.de: Next we'll be turning the &6Saturated Tau&r into &4Blood Shards&r
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest28.de: Once we have done our first rituals, and upgraded our blood altar to tier 4, we get access to the next tier of &5Ritual Diviner&r
This tier gives us access to all rituals that bloodmagic has to offer
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest29.de: The next ritual in the line of dungeons.
The Gateway allows us full access to the endless realm.
Instead of only 4 rooms, we now have access to an infinite generating dungeon.
This dungeon can contain 2 important things for us.
This will give us access to the mines when used on a door with a special (blue colored instead of red) lock.
This has a rare chance to spawn in a few rooms in the regular endless realm, and is found more consistenly in the mines.
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest3.des: Every tier of the altar allows you to create a new tier of &8Slate&r
These slates are used to create runes that improve the altar, and many more things in blood magic
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest30.de: Now find a special door, and get access to the mines.
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest31.de: These keys are dropped by some mobs in the mines, and allow you to explore it further.
They can also be crafted, however they require something called crystalized will.
The blood magic book has more information on how to obtain this.
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest32.de: Demonite is the last thing we'll need to upgrade our blood altar to tier 5.
You'll need a total of 36 ingots
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest34.de: At the start, self sacrifice is going to be your main way of obtaining blood.
There is 2 ways to improve this.
You can replace the blank runes in your altar with runes of self sacrifice, these increase the amount of blood gained from self sacrifise
This makes it so that the dagger does not take half a heart, but all the health it can take from you without killing you.
Just place it close to the blood altar
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest35.de: This is only the start of the blood magic quest line.
At the moment, this book only contains the self sacrifice way of getting blood. While this is fine to start with, its not going to last you long into the pack
Without going into details (Future versions will have this explained more) your main 2 options for blood are
Combining Hostile Neural Networks with bloodmagic to automate blood gathering.
A ritual that damages mobs in a range, and adds blood to the altar based on that.
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest36.ta: &2This quest was made by MiniMaxi!&r&1 Thank you a lot!&r
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest37.de: There are &b3 custom Mark of the Falling Tower Rituals&r available:
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest38.de: Good Luck crafting it. Dont hate me.
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest39.de: Make this and connect it to ae2 to start autmating blood magic.  (requires patters and cards to work)
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest4.des: The &3Hellfire Forge&r is another one of the different crafting methods available within blood magic.
This uses souls instead of blood to craft.
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest40.de: Make these to make patterns for the blood assembler to automate blood magic crafting.
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest41.de: add me to blood assembler to craft tier 2 recipes
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest42.de: add me to blood assembler to craft tier 3 recipes
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest43.de: add me to blood assembler to craft tier 4 recipes
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest44.de: add me to blood assembler to craft tier 5 recipes

ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest46.de: this decreases the time between crafts for the blood assembler.
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest5.des: The &3Soul Snare&r allows you to gather souls from mobs you killed.
Simply throw it at a mob, once you see white particles surrounding the mob you'll know it worked.
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest6.des: These &3Tartaric Gems&r allow you to store souls in them, thereby allowing you to craft with more souls.
Theres also can be used to craft the &3Sentient Sword&r, which will allow you to obtain souls without needing soul snares.
ftbquests.chapter.blood_magic.quest7.des: As mentioned in the previous chapter, mobs killed by the &3Sentient Sword&r drops souls without the need of soul snares

ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest1.descrip: Here, you'll discover the famous flowery magi-tech mod !
The quests in this quest line should be enough but you can always consult the &aLexica Botania&r.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest1.subtitl: Start of the Botania Quest Line
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest1.title: Welcome to &aBotania&r !
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest19.descri: The &3Petal Apothecary&r is the first crafting apparatus of &aBotania&r.
It will allow you to create &eFunctional&r Flowers but more importantly, create &6Generating&r Flowers.

&eFunctional&r Flowers are flowers that each have a specific function. They aren't really useful as other mods are better at what they do. If you want to use them, you can see all of them in the &aLexica Botania&r, chapter "Functional flora"
&6Generating&r Flowers are flowers that produce &bmana&r. Each flower generate mana in a different way which will be described in their respective quests.
To use the &3Petal Apothecary&r, fill it with water and throw all the ingredients into it then throw a seed.
* Recipes that uses &5Runes&r won't consume them, once the craft is done you will get them back
* Once you have completed a recipe, right click on the &3Petal Apothecary&r with an empty hand to repeat the craft.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest19.title: Creating flowers
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest2.descrip: To start &aBotania&r, you will need to gather all the colors of &9Mystical Flowers&r.
Use the &2Floral Fertilizer&r like normal Bone Meal but instead of growing Grass, it will make &9Mystical Flowers&r appear !
The &dFlower Pouch&r can be used to store &9Mystical Flowers&r.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest20.descri: The &ePure Daisy&r is the first and the most important &eFunctional&r flower.
It will allow you to create &2Livingwood&r and &7Livingrock&r by converting respectively Logs and Stone.
Simply place the blocks you want to convert next to it (the max radius is 1 so you can only convert 8 blocks at a time) and wait 60 seconds.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest20.title: The most important &eFunctional&r flower
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest21.descri: The &6Endoflame&r is the first &6Generating&r flower you will craft.
It produces &bmana&r by burning any fuel dropped in a 7×7×7 area around it.
It will always produce 30 &bmana&r per seconds but fuels that burn longer will produce &bmana&r longer
Fuels that burn longer then 1600 seconds will burn for 1600 seconds
Also, it will only burn one fuel at a time, dropping 2 coal will consume one and leave the second.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest21.title: The first &6Generating&r flower
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest22.descri: The &bMana pool&r allows you to store &bmana&r.
To use it, connect a &2Mana Spreader&r to it using the &2Wand of the Forest&r.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest22.title: &bMana&r storage
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest23.descri: The &2Wand of the Forest&r is &aBotania's&r wrench.
Holding it will allow you to see specific information about &aBotania's&r blocks like the amount of &bmana&r currently in them.
It has two modes, &5Bind&r and &3Function&r. Shift right-click with it in the air to change the mode.
&5Bind mode&r is used to bind blocks together by sneak right-clicking. The bind order is always first the "generator" then the "consumer". Specific uses will be described in the quests using it.
&3Function mode&r acts like a normal wrench from other mods, it can rotate blocks. Specific uses will be described in the quests using it.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest23.title: &2Wand of the Forest&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest24.title: &2Livingwood&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest25.title: &7Livingrock&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest26.descri: The &2Mana Spreader&r is used to move &bmana&r around.
Using the &2Wand of the Forest&r bind &6Generating&r flowers to it and bind it to a &bMana Pool&r.
While holding the &2Wand of the Forest&r, you will see the path that the &bmana&r will take.

Take into consideration the distance between the &2Mana Spreader&r and the &bMana Pool&r as the &2Mana Spreader&r will only shoot a burst of &bmana&r if the current burst is finished and some &bmana&r is lost the further it has to go.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest26.title: &2Mana Spreader&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest27.descri: The &bMana Tablet&r can be used to transfer &bmana&r from one pool to another.
Simply toss the tablet into a pool and choose the right mode for the pool using the &2Wand of the Forest&r. Either fill the tablet or empty the tablet.
&bMana Tablets&r can store half a &bMana Pool&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest27.title: &bMana&r transfer between pools
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest28.descri: The &bMana Splitter&r is used to split a burst of &bmana&r to 4 different pools.
Bind the &2Mana Spreader&r to the &bMana Splitter&r and place 4 pools around it.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest28.title: &bMana Splitter&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest29.descri: The &bBand of Mana&r is a portable &bMana Tablet&r.
Certain items will need the &bmana&r stored in this to work.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest30.descri: Same as the &bBand of Mana&r but will store 2 &bMana Pools&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest31.descri: By throwing certain items in a &bMana pool&r, they will transform in their &bmana-infused&r conterparts.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest31.title: &bMana-infused&r items
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest32.descri: Throw a Black Lotus in a non-empty &bMana Pool&r and it will fill it with some &bmana&r.
Can be found in chests in structures but can also be crafted.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest32.title: "Free" &bmana&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest33.descri: This armor offers the same protection as an iron armor but with better enchantability and durability.
It is able to repair itself using &bmana&r from the player's inventory.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest33.title: Manasteel Armor
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest34.descri: Comparable to iron tools but with better enchantability and durability.
They are able to repair themselves using &bmana&r from the player's inventory.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest34.title: Manasteel Tools
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest35.descri: &aBotania's&r &bMana Lenses&r can be given to &2Mana Spreader&r to make hem more effective.
The basic &bMana Lense&r does nothing but by upgrading it you can make the &bmana&r bursts do lots of things.
There are a lot of different Lenses and you can read all about them in the &aLexica Botania&r, chapter "Mana Manipulation" → "Mana Lenses"
You can also combine 2 different Lenses to combine their powers.
I won't tell you which are the best but you can deduce it by looking at the &2Mana Spreader&r quest.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest35.title: &2Mana Spreader&r upgrades
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest36.descri: The &7Runic Altar&r is the second crafting apparatus you'll create.
It's main use is to craft &5Runes&r.
It uses &bmana&r to craft items, the only way to give it &bmana&r is by one or multiple &2Mana Spreaders&r to it.
Right click the ingredients on it and use the &2Wand of the Forest&r to see the crafting progress.
Once done, toss a &7Livingrock&r on top of the &7Runic Altar&r and right click it with the &2Wand of the Forest&r.
* Recipes that uses &5Runes&r won't consume them, once the craft is done you will get them back
* Once you have completed a recipe, right click on the &7Runic Altar&r with an empty hand to repeat the craft.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest36.title: &7Runic Altar&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest42.descri: Though the &9Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate&r in the next quest can be provided &bmana&r using &2Mana Spreaders&r, it is recommended to use &eSparks&r as their &bmana&r transfer rate is much higher.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest42.title: &eSparks&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest43.descri: The &9Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate&r is used to craft better ingots by combining multiple ingredients.

It is a multiblock so it needs a little structure made of 5 &7Livingrocks&r and 4 blocks of Lapis Lazuli in a checkerboard pattern with the &9Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate&r on top of the center &7Livingrock&r.
To send it &bmana&r, place a &eSpark&r on a &bMana Pool&r and another on the &9Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate&r. You can place more &eSparks&r on top of &bMana Pools&r and the craft will be faster.
To craft, toss all items on top of it.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest43.title: &9Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest44.descri: When placed under a &bMana Pool&r, the &7Alchemy Catalyst&r allows form items to transformed in other items.
Look at the uses of the &7Alchemy Catalyst&r in JEI to see all the transformations.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest44.title: &7Alchemy Catalyst&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest45.descri: The &bBand of Aura&r is a portable &bmana&r generator.
It will passively create 1 &bmana&r per 50 seconds and store it in the player's &bMana Tablet&r or &bBand of Mana&r.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest46.descri: Same as the &bBand of Aura&r but will create &bmana&r at a way faster rate of 10 &bmana&r per seconds.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest47.descri: The first ingot you will make with the &9Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate&r is the &aTerrasteel Ingot&r.
It is crafted with 1 Manasteel Ingot, one Mana Pearl and one Mana Diamond.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest47.title: &aTerrasteel Ingot&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest48.descri: The &aTerrasteel&r Armor is a Diamond Armor.
It has more Armor Toughness and even has Knockback Resistance.
Just like the Manasteel Armor, it will repair itself with &bmana&r.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest48.title: Terresteel Armor
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest49.descri: Similar to Diamond Tools but with abilities !
The &aTerra Blade&r will sometimes shoot a beam of green particles dealing the same damage as the Terra Blade would with a melee hit.

The &aTerra Shatterer&r will use &bmana&r imbued inside it by throwing it in a &bMana Pool&r to upgrade it's rank. The better the rank, the more blocks it will mine in width and height when it's ability is on (sneak right-click to toggle). The SS rank which is the best will mine in an 9x9 area.
The &aTerra Truncator&r will chop entire trees down.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest49.title: Terrasteel Tools
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest50.descri: The &dPortal to Alfheim&r is the third and last crafting apparatus of &aBotania&r.
It will allow you to trade ressources with &dAlfheim's&r residents for better ones.
To make it, look at the quest "Portal Structure" above this one.
To open It, right click on the Elven Gateway Core with a &2Wand of the Forest&r.
Make sure that there are at least 2 &bMana Pools&r with Natura Pylons on top with at least 100,000 &bmana&r in each of them in an 11x11x11 area around the core.
The activation doesn't consume the &bmana&r but throwing items into the portal will. Make sure you don't run out of &bmana&r as it will close the portal and everything thrown into it will be deleted.
Also, throwing anything into the portal other then items that can be exchanged will delete the item, be careful !
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest50.title: &dPortal to Alfheim&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest52.descri: Throw your &aLexica Botania&r in the &dAlfheim Portal&r to get a better one upgraded with Elven knowledge.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest52.title: Better &aLexica Botania&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest53.descri: The Elves will trade your &bMana-infused&r resources for &dAlfheim&r resources.
Just throw them in the portal !
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest53.title: &dAlfheim&r resources
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest54.descri: Just like the &7Alchemy Catalyst&r but will duplicate some resources at the cost of &bmana&r.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest54.title: &7Conjuration Catalyst&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest55.descri: Like their name implies, the &eSpark Augments&r will allow you to upgrade / control your &eSparks&r like you want.
Dispersive Augment: The &eSpark&r will try to drain the &bmana&r in its pool to charge nearby player's &bMana Tablet&r or &bBand of Mana&r.
Dominant Augment: The &eSpark&r will try to take the &bmana&r from other Sparks pools to their own pool.
Recessive Augment: The &eSpark&r will try to empty it's pool to other Sparks pools.
Isolated Augment: Will stop all interactions with Dominant or Recessive &eSparks&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest55.title: &eSpark Augments&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest56.descri: Identical to the Manasteel Armor but has a chance to spawn Pixies when the player is hurt.
Just like the Manasteel Armor, it will repair itself with &bmana&r.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest56.title: Elementium Armor
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest57.descri: Similar to Manasteel Tools but special abilities.
Pickaxe : will delete "mundane blocks" like Cobblestone or Dirt" can be combined with a Terra Shatterer to get it's effect.
Be careful, this process cannot be undone.
Axe : has a chance to drop mob skulls.
Shovel : if it breaks a gravity-affected block, it will also break the block above it.
Hoe : when creating Farmland, il will be watered.
Shears : will shear every sheep in an 11 block radius.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest57.title: Elementium Tools
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest58.descri: Your next objective is to fight the &5Guardian of Gaia&r to obtain &dGaia Spirits&r.
To do so, you will need to summon him using 4 Gaia Pylons and an active Beacon.
To make the structure, look at the quest "Gaia Structure" above this one.
When you are prepared, use a &aTerrasteel Ingot&r on the Beacon by shift right-clicking to summon the &5Guardian of Gaia&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest58.title: Fighting the &5Guardian of Gaia&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest60.descri: Upgraded &2Mana Spreader&r, will send 1.5 times more &bmana&r.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest61.descri: Upgraded Elven Mana Spreader, will send 4 times more &bmana&r then the normal &2Mana Spreader&r.
The best Mana Spreader you can get. If you are producing more &bmana&r then it can handle you should look at the Botanical Machinery + Extra Quest Line.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest62.title: &dGaia Spirits&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest63.descri: Craft a Gaia Spirit Ingot and use it on the Beacon to summon the &5Guardian of Gaia 2.0&r.
It is a bit more powerful but drops way more &dGaia Spirits&r !
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest63.title: Fighting the &5Guardian of Gaia 2.0&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest64.descri: Right-click to pickup the spawner, right-click to place the spawner.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest65.descri: Allows the wearer to fly like in creative, consuming 1400 &bmana&r per second to do so.
You should definetly use a &bMana mirror&r with this.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest66.descri: Can store up to 2,147,483,647 of a single block type if more blocks is inputed, they will be voided.
When the talisman is empty, right-click to set the block it should store. Otherwise, the blocks stored in it will be placed.
Shift right-clicking it in the air will toggle between enabled and disabled. When enabled, it will absorb all of the selected block from the player's inventory.
Placing the Talisman in the crafting grid will allow to extract stacks of the contained item and disable the Talisman at the same time.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest67.descri: The &bMana Mirror&r is an extremely useful item capable of linking itself to a &bMana Pool&r to provide wireless &bmana&r to it's user.
Shift right-click a &bMana Pool&r to link.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest67.title: &bMana Mirror&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest68.descri: The &5Guardian of Gaia 2.0&r will drop a &2Dice of Fate&r.
The &2Dice of Fate&r can be right-clicked to roll one of 6 relics.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest69.descri: Allows teleportation to a specific block.
Shift right-clicking a block will set the target location.
Holding the right-click for 2 seconds will teleport the player to the target location using 10 &bmana&r per block of distance from the target location.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest70.descri: Powerful weapon launching exploding projectiles (won't break blocks).
Hold right-click to charge and release right-click to launch.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest72.descri: When equiped in a Bauble slot, shift right-clicking with an empty hand will select a location that will be the source block.
Continue selecting other blocks to copy their relative position to the first block.
After that, shift right-clicking while placing a block will also place the same block to the relative position of the first block placed using the position of the selected blocks.
Shift right-clicking with an empty hand on the source block 3 times will delete all selections.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest73.descri: With it equiped in a Bauble slot, the &aTerra Shatterer&r will mine 1 more block in every direction (including depth).
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest74.descri: With it equiped in a Bauble slot, the player will gain an additional 20 health points (10 Hearts) and become immune to suffocation, drowning, fire, lava, starvation and fall damage.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest75.descri: Just like items, you can store your &bmana&r in the AE2 system.
To use the &bmana&r in a pattern importer / exporter or any other thing that can be filtered, right click with a &bMana Tablet&r to set the filter to &bmana&r.
You can put &bmana&r into your patterns. The image below is the conversion.
You can place &bmana&r with right clicking a mana tablet inside a pattern.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest75.title: Applied Energistics Integration
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest76.rich_d: Go take a look at the
Though not necessary for progression, they are way faster, produce more
and can be automated using AE2 or RS2.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest76.title: There is machines ???
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest77.descri: Now that you have &dAlfheim&r resources, the next step is the &5Guardian of Gaia&r fight.
You'll need Alfsteel to create the Gaia Pylons.
Make Alfsteel in the &9Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate&r !
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest78.task_1: &2This quest was made by MiniMaxi!&r&1 Thank you a lot!&r
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest79.descri: Best flower in the Pack (need Greenhouse to use it to 100%%)
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest80.descri: At some point in your progression as a &abotanist&r, your flowers will create &bmana&r so fast that &espreaders&r are not enough to handle it.
With the &6Mana Collector&r, you can put mana generated from flowers directly into a &dspark network&r.
The &6Mana Collector&r acts as a little &estorage&r that can receive mana from flowers and interact with &dsparks&r.
To extract the mana from the collector, you'll most likely need a &cRecessive Spark Augment&r.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.title: Botania
ftbquests.chapter.botanic.quest1.descrip: Can't provide water via AE2 so provide it with water somehow and delete the water from the pattern.
ftbquests.chapter.botanic.quest41.descri: The &eGreenhouse&r is a high-tech machine capable of producing &amassive amounts of Mana&r when fully upgraded.
It consumes &eenergy&r and &efuel&r that is eaten by the inserted &aFlower&r.
To use the &8Wither Aconite&r you need at least
At first, the fuel slots are &clocked&r.
• Fuel slots unlock only after placing a &aFlower&r in the top slot
• Only valid fuel items for that flower can be inserted
The Greenhouse can be enhanced using &eGreenhouse Upgrades&r.
With enough upgrades, the Greenhouse becomes the &abest Mana generators&r available, perfect for large-scale Botania automation.
ftbquests.chapter.botanic.quest41.title: &2Greenhouse&r
ftbquests.chapter.botanic.quest8.descrip: It doesn't auto-output items so you'll need to collect them somehow. The next tier auto outputs.
ftbquests.chapter.botanic.title: Botanical Machinery + Extra
ftbquests.chapter.bounty_board.title: Kill, Kill, KILL!!!!!!

Build massive multiblocks, generate extreme amounts of energy, and unlock experimental AE technology beyond standard limitations.
There is a &avideo tutorial for every feature&r.
ftbquests.chapter.crazy_ae2.quest1.title: Getting Started with Crazy AE2

ftbquests.chapter.hostile_neural_network: &6Hostile Neural Networks&r (or HNN for short) is a mod based around simulating mob kills for loot! \\n\\nTo do this, you will be collecting 'data' on mobs, then running simulations from the data to create their drops!
You cant put the Chaos Dragon Data Model inside the Simualting Modeling and you should not put it inside the Merger!

Have a bunch of &5Loot Fabricators&r all piped together? This tool can help you make sure they all have the same processing settings so they know what to make out of their predictions. Simply set the recipes you want in one machine, and then you can copy-paste them into all the other machines with ease.
&9Sneak&r + &4Right Click&r: Copy the settings from a machine.
&9Sneak&r + &4Right Click&r the air: Clear the saved settings.

The &9Deep Learner&r is one of the core components of HNN. \\n\\nWith this item, you can right click to open up a HUD and store &6Data Models&r to gather data while killing mobs. \\n\\nEach Learner can hold 4 Data Models, and as long as you have the Learner anywhere in your inventory, it will collect data for the models placed inside! \\n\\nNote: You can have multiple Deep Learners in your inventory, and it will count the kills for all Data Models inside all of the Learners.

&9Model Frameworks&r are the starting point for creating Data Models. \\n\\nTo start collecting data on a specific mob, you'll want to make one of these then &9right click&r the mob you'd like to gather data on. When done properly, the Model Framework will turn into the Data Model of the mob you clicked on. \\n\\nTo 'gather data' for that mob, place the newly created Data Model inside of a &aDeep Learner&r, then start killing that specific mob with the Deep Learner in your inventory.

The &dSimulation Chamber&r is the main machine within HNN. \\n\\nWhen given power, it will run simulations based on the &bData Model&r that is placed inside. The power required also depends on the Data Model placed inside, and can be seen within the Model's tooltip.  \\n\\nThe machine also requires at least one &9Prediction Matrix&r to run a simulation. \\n\\nThe result of the simulation will be output onto the Matrix. Simulations will always produce some kind of &eGeneralized Prediction&r, which can be used in various crafting recipes. They also vary depending on the origin of the mob in the Data Model. \\n\\nIf the simulation succeeds, you will receive a &dMob Prediction&r based off of the model. The higher the tier of the Data Model used, the higher the success rate is for a simulation.

The &5Loot Fabricator&r is the machine that gets you that sweet, sweet loot from Mob Predictions. \\n\\nWhen given power and a successful Mob Prediction, you will be able to choose which item you'd like to get from that mob's Data Model. The machine will remember your choice, so it can be automated. \\n\\nNotable Mob Predictions: \\n\\n- &dEnder Dragons&r for &dDragon Eggs&r \\n- &2Zombies&r for Iron \\n- &0Withers&r for &5Nether Stars&r

Once you make your first Data Model, you'll need to level it up to be useful. \\n\\nData Models start out at the first tier: &7Faulty&r. You'll need to at least level it to &aBasic&r if you'd like to run some simulations on it! \\n\\nOnce placed inside of the Deep Learner, the HUD will tell you how many kills are required to level it up. You can also see this info in the tooltip of the Model itself, although you'll have to do math.
Like the regular &5Loot Fabricator&r, except this machine can process predictions &24 at a time!&r So much loot!
Using &eExtra Data Models&r, this machine can simulate mobs in parallel for 4x the output!
The Merger Camera lets you combine 4 &6Self-Aware&r Data Models along with an &8Extra Model Framework&r to create a combined &eExtra Data Model&r that can then be used in the &9Ultimate Machines&r.
You can combine 4 of the same model into one, or you can mix and match between different mob types as needed so long as they are all at the &6Self-Aware&r tier.

The &9Simulator Modeling&r machine allows you to upgrade your models faster without having to leave them in a &9Simulation Chamber&r. While your models won't produce predictions in this machine, this can help you quickly get your models up to the &6Self Aware&r level required to put them in the &9Merger Camera&r!
A model needs to be at least &aBasic&r tier to be leveled up by this machine, &7Faulty&r models aren't good enough.
This machine also has &6upgrade slots&r to improve it's functionality. (Note: additional upgrades of the same type do not stack their effects in this machine.)

Provides enough data to &ainstantly level up a model&r to the next tier with each machine cycle, but &cdrasticly increases energy consumption&r.
Makes the machine &awork 50%% faster&r, at the cost of &cdoubled power consumtion&r.

ftbquests.chapter.masterful_machinery.qu: The Masterful Machinery Multiblock machines are custom made to streamline automation. From early on to the end of progression there will be a use for these machines.
Use the Priority Setter to set the priority of output ports if your machine has multiple.
Instructions on how to use it are in the tooltip.
Higher priority = output first
Tip: Make a Multibuilder Tool!.
Masterful Machinery
The Mechanical Empowerer removes the fiddly automation from the Actually Additions' Empowerer and a few other recipes. Notably, the automation of EnderIO recipes including Soul Vials.
For all available recipes look up the uses of the Mechanical Empowerer Controller.
A basic water generator. Higher Tiers provide more water per operation.

The Advanced Awakening Altar combines a few of the most used recipes from Draconic Evolution's Infusion crafting and Mystical Agriculture's Awakening Altar into one Block. This makes automation of Awakened Draconium and Awakened Supremium a breeze.
The Multi Compressor Machine has the single purpose in helping you make singularities faster. Producing the required resources fast enough is for you to figure out.
The recipes for each singularity may differ from the ones in the Quantum Compressor so make sure to check JEI!
The EssenceForge is your mid- to endgame resource production using Mystical Agriculture.

Using some Ether Gas the EssenceForge processes Mystical Agriculture seeds to produce the corresponding essences. The seeds and cruxes are NOT consumed, as is indicated by the small &4x&r in the recipe.
Higher Tier EssenceForges require multiple seeds to be present in the input port at once. For all requirements see the uses of the EssenceForge in JEI.
It is recommended to use the Fire Attuned Machine to produce the necessary Ether Gas in later gamestages.

The Multi Compactor Machine compacts (who would have thought?!) Mystical Agriculture Essences and ProjectE Alchemical Fuels. As a bonus you can try to produce the elusive Intricate Hellforged Parts with huge amounts of Coal and Gems (WIP).
For all available recipes look up the uses of the Multi Compactor Machine Controller.

The Resource Foundry is the multiblock for creating a lot of items. You input essences and get items back. And because its 1 big craft and not many small ones it does not take as much server resources.
The Infinity Cell Factory is you best friend for creating all your Infinity Cells.
&2Quests added by Aquadin.&r
&1Thank you a lot!&r
&2Quests added by Aquadin.&r &1Thank you a lot!&r
The Tank Encapsulator Multiblock lets you create some Fluid and Chemical Tanks so you dont have problems with NBT.
The Event Horizon Antimatter Synthesizer is a powerful alternative to produce Mekanism Antimatter. It is recommended to use multiple Synthesizers in conjunction with a Mekanism Naquadah Reactor.

You can refer to the Mekanism Naquadah Reactor quest line for every production step in their regular machines. JEI will show all available replacement recipes using the Event Horizon Antimatter Synthesizer Controller.
The Fire Attuned Machine offers a few high temperature recipes.
Example uses:
- Early Lava
- Life Essence
- Ether Gas
For all available recipes look up the uses of the Fire Attuned Machine Controller.
The Loot Fabrication Plant produces loot from mob predictions.
Unlike the Loot Fabricator you don't choose an item in the GUI but place the desired item in the input port along the predictions. The "blueprint" item will not get consumed.
For all available loot fabrications look up the uses of the Loot Fabrication Plant Controller.
The Prediction Chamber Machine is the big brother to the (Extra) Hostile Neural Networks' Simulation Chambers.
To function the Prediction Chamber requires Prediction Matrices and an Extra Data Model (Tier: Omnipotent) comprised of a single mob.
For all usable Data Models look up the uses of the Prediction Chamber Controller.
The Infinity Crucible is the way to automate renewable Draconic Evolution Chaos Shards.
The Pinky Machine accelerates the production of two pink-ish ingots.
The Auto Crusher Machine provides selected hammering and crushing related recipes.
Recommended as part of basic resource generation in conjunction with the Auto Sieve Machine.
Note: Not all recipes are available for all Machine Tiers.
For all available recipes look up the uses of the Auto Crusher Machine Controller.
The Auto Sieve will provide the basic resources you need in your daily skyblock adventures.
Processing speed and amounts increase with Multiblock Tier.
For all available recipes look up the uses of the Auto Sieve Machine Controller.

Probability-wise, processing 64 blocks in a manual sieve is better than using higher-tier auto sieves. The trade‑off is speed and automation: auto sieves are much faster and fully automatable, but they don’t increase your per‑block chances.

ftbquests.chapter.mystical_agriculture.q: &dEssence&r is the starting point for all of your growing needs in Mystical Agriculture.
&eInferium Essence&r is the base tier of all essences. You can get this from mining, killing mobs, or by making seeds to grow them!
To make the bigger and better essences, you'll need to make an &9Infusion Crystal&r.

The &aWatering Can&r is used to increase the speed that crops grow. Higher tiers have a larger area of effect. To use this, fill it up with some water by right clicking some water, then hold right click near your crops to water them!
Shift+right click while looking in the air with the watering can to enable auto-watering.
&eEssence Farmland&r will increase the growth speed of the seeds. The certain seeds will require certain farmlands to be planted on.

&9Growth Accelerators&r very slightly increase the growth speed of a seed when placed directly underneath the farmland. Each tier has a range of how many blocks "up" it can accelerate, with Inferium being the lowest at 12.
Starting with Inferium Essence, you can create ingots to make both Essence &9Tools&r and &9Armor&r.
Essence tools can be upgraded to higher tiers, and just like the Armor, they can be &5Augmented&r in the &3Tinkering Table&r.
The best seed in the modpack.
It cant be tick accelerated and cant be put into a botanypot.
&7While the mutant enderman is dying, you can actually collect &dendersoul fragments&7 by right-clicking them before they explode.
&7Now with some &dendersoul fragments&7 following you, all you have to do is drop (&enot right-click&7) an &5eye of ender&7.

&7Also, if your &dendersoul hand&7 is running out of uses and you have some spare &dendersoul fragments&7, just toss out your &dendersoul hand&7 while the fragments are following you and it'll recharge the hand again (&fwith 60 uses each fragment&7).
The &9Tinkering Table&r is used to upgrade &aEssence Gear&r with &dAugments&r.
Augments can be made using the Infusion Altar. Just like the Essences, Augments have tiers!
The &9Infusion Altar&r is the bread and butter of creating &aSeeds&r in the mod. You'll need to create the Altar itself, as well as 8 Pedestals.
Placing the Altar down first will show you where to put the Pedestals. To craft a seed, place the required mats in each pedestal, then give a redstone signal to the Altar.
&dMystical Agriculture&r is a mod based around the concept of growing your resources with crops. Use crops to grow essences used to make materials, mob drops, tools, armor and possibly even more!
Most seeds are simple to make, but to make &9Mob Seeds&r, you'll need to head to the Nether to pick up some &8Soulium&r.

With the stone and ore that you find, you'll need to use these to make the &3Soulium Dagger&r and &3Soul Jars&r. Using the dagger to kill mobs, you'll be able to gather their &bsouls&r, which are used in the Infusion Altar to create the respective mob seeds.
Alternatively, you can fill Soul Jars inside of the &3Soul Extractor&r by inserting a jar and using mob items to fill them. For example, adding Rotten Flesh will give a portion of a Zombie Soul.
To awaken your Supremium Essence, you'll need to create a new Altar and 4 new Pedestals, as well as a new type of pedestal called the &cEssence Vessel&r.
The Essence Vessels will require the starter Element Essences to fill: Fire, Water, Earth, and Air.
To start making &aEssence Gear&r, you'll need to make the Inferium Armor first.
This gear can be upgraded to higher tiers, just like the Essences. You can also &9Augment&r them with the &bTinkering Table&r!
&bProsperity Shards&r are used as one of the main crafting mats for several of the recipes in Mystical Agriculture, like seeds, ingots, and more.
This special essence is used for making most of the &6Creative&r items.

ftbquests.chapter.neo_eco_ae2.quest1.des: The &bEnergized Budding Crystal &ris a key material in &2Neo ECO AE Extension&r and works like AE2's Budding Certus Quartz, but grows &3Energized Crystals&r instead.
There are four quality tiers: &aFlawless&r, &eFlawed&r, &6Chipped&r, and &cDamaged&r, with higher tiers growing faster and lasting longer.
You can obtain Energized Budding Crystals in two main ways: via &elightning strikes &ron AE2 Budding Certus Quartz, or by using the &6Crystal Fixer &rfrom ExtendedAE.
With lightning, each Budding Quartz tier converts to a matching Energized Budding tier; blocks hit directly by the strike have the highest conversion chance.
Using a &6Lightning Rod &ror a &6Charged Snowball &rlets you control where the lightning hits and makes conversion much more reliable.

With the &6Crystal Fixer&r, you can upgrade &3Energized Crystals&r step by step into &cDamaged&r, &6Chipped&r, and eventually &eFlawed Budding Energized Crystals&r, though the last step has a very low success rate.
Once placed, &bEnergized Budding Crystals &rslowly grow &3Energized Crystal clusters&r, which you can harvest and use for almost all advanced components and multiblock parts in this mod.
You can speed up crystal growth by placing &aAE2 Growth Accelerators&r around the &bEnergized Budding Crystal &rblocks, just like with normal Budding Certus Quartz.
ftbquests.chapter.neo_eco_ae2.quest21.de: The &aIntegrated Working Station &ris the central crafting machine in &2Neo ECO AE Extension&r and combines multiple AE2 device functions into one powerful workstation.
It features &b9 input slots&r, separate &9fluid input &rand &9fluid output &rtanks (16,000 mB each), and runs on &6FE power &rfrom your ME network or external sources.

This machine is required to craft almost all advanced components, including &3Crystal Ingots&r, &3Energized Superconductive Ingots&r, ECO cell components, computation cells, and all three multiblock controllers.
To use it, place the station, connect it to your &9ME Network&r, insert items and fluids, ensure enough &6FE&r is available, and let it process automatically.
You can install &eAE2 Speed Upgrades &rto drastically reduce crafting time and enable &eAuto Export &rto push finished products into adjacent inventories or buses.
Think of it as a hybrid of Inscriber, Fluid Encoder, and advanced crafting unit, specifically designed for the high-tier recipes of &2Neo ECO AE Extension&r.
ftbquests.chapter.neo_eco_ae2.quest27.de: The &2ECO Storage System &rsupports a wide range of specialized storage cells, each optimized for a specific resource type.
All Omni matrices are built by combining an &5Omni Housing &rwith matching &2ECO Storage Components &rin the &aIntegrated Working Station&r, and can be disassembled later to recover parts.
Use Omni matrices when you want to store many different resource types compactly in your &2ECO Drives &rinstead of using separate item, fluid, or energy cells.

You can insert &3ECO Item Storage Cells&r, &9ECO Fluid Storage Cells&r, &bECO Chemical Storage Cells&r, &6ECO FE Storage Cells&r, and &eECO Mana Storage Cells&r, all the way up to &b256MB &rcapacity per cell.
These dedicated cells are very efficient for large amounts of a single resource type, such as items, fluids, energy, mana, or chemicals, and have relatively low idle drain.
However, if you want to store many different resource types together in one cell, the &5Compatibility Storage Matrices &rfrom &5AE2 Omni Cells &rprovide a powerful alternative.
The &5Compatibility Storage Matrices &rextend the &2ECO Storage System&r to support many different resource types in a single cell, including items, fluids, energy, chemicals, and more.
There are three families: &5Omni&r, &5Complex Omni&r, and &5Quantum Omni&r, each with different type limits, capacities, and idle energy drain.
Standard &5Omni Cells &rcan store up to &b63 different types &rof resources in one cell, with capacities of &b16MB, 64MB, or 256MB &rand relatively low idle drain.
&5Complex Omni Cells &rincrease the type limit dramatically (up to thousands of types) but consume much more &6AE/t &rwhile idle, making them better for large, diverse networks.
&5Quantum Omni Cells &rhave &dno type limit &rand &b4× the capacity &rof standard Omni cells, but their idle drain is extremely high and should only be used in well-powered endgame bases.

ftbquests.chapter.neo_eco_ae2.quest47.de: The &2ECO Storage System &ris the first of the three major multiblocks in &2Neo ECO AE Extension&r and replaces your standard ME drives with a single, scalable storage structure.
It consists of a &6tiered controller&r, &3ECO Drives &rfor storage cells, matching &bEnergy Cells &rfor massive AE buffer, and structural parts like &7Casing&r and &aInterface&r.
There are three tiers: &bL4&r, &6L6&r, and &5L9&r, which determine the maximum capacity per cell (&316MB, 64MB, or 256MB&r) and the internal energy storage (&b10M, 100M, or 1B AE&r).
Higher tiers provide significantly more storage per cell and much larger internal AE buffers, making &6L6 &rand &5L9 &ressential for late-game networks.
The multiblock is &2fully modular&r: you can start with a small structure and expand it up to 15 blocks in length, consisting of up to 11 cell slots and 4 casing blocks.
The multiblock is built around the controller, with &3ECO Drives &rextending to the right and &bEnergy Cells &rplaced behind each drive column for power supply.

You can insert &3ECO Item Storage Cells&r, &9ECO Fluid Storage Cells&r, &bECO Chemical Storage Cells&r, &6ECO FE Storage Cells&r, &eECO Mana Storage Cells&r, and &5ECO Omni Cells &r(including &5Complex Omni &rand &5Quantum Omni&r) up to 256MB capacity.
Each &3ECO Drive &rholds exactly one storage cell, and you can expand the structure by adding more drive columns and matching energy columns to increase total capacity.
Use this system when vanilla ME drives and 256k cells are not enough and you want to store millions and billions of items, fluids, energy, mana, and mixed resources.
ftbquests.chapter.neo_eco_ae2.quest51.de: The &2ECO Crafting System &ris the advanced pattern-provider multiblock in &2Neo ECO AE Extension&r and turns your ME network into a high-throughput crafting factory.

Unlike the &2Computation System&r, which manages crafting jobs, the &2Crafting System &rexecutes patterns directly and can run many patterns in parallel thanks to &3Workers&r, &6Parallel Cores&r, and &3Pattern Buses&r.
There are three controller tiers: &bF4&r, &6F6&r, and &5F9&r, which define the base and overclocked batch size per task slot (32 → 128, 256, or 512 crafts per slot).
Higher tiers give much larger batches per slot and more structural overclock potential, making &6F6 &rand &5F9 &ressential for mass production of complex items.
The multiblock is modular and can be expanded by adding more &3Workers&r, &6Parallel Cores&r, and &3Pattern Buses&r to increase parallel threads and total crafting throughput.
The &aCrafting Interface &rconnects the structure to your ME network, while &cInput &rand &9Output Hatches &rhandle coolant for active cooling and overclocking.
Use this system when you need extreme autocrafting speed for large recipes, bulk materials, or endgame components that would choke on vanilla pattern providers.
ftbquests.chapter.neo_eco_ae2.quest51.ri: With active cooling and network exchange (x2 / x8 modes),
to multiply crafts per slot and share patterns across the network.
ftbquests.chapter.neo_eco_ae2.quest53.de: The &2ECO Computation System &ris the crafting-CPU multiblock in &2Neo ECO AE Extension&r and replaces vanilla AE2 crafting CPUs with a massively parallel cluster.
It provides multiple &6Threading Cores &rfor simultaneous crafting jobs and &6Parallel Cores &ras accelerators that significantly speed up individual crafting operations.
There are three controller tiers: &bC4&r, &6C6&r, and &5C9&r, which define threads (1, 2, or 4), accelerators (64, 192, or 576), and storage per cell (64MB, 256MB, or 1GB).
Higher tiers give far more threads, way more accelerators, and much larger storage per &2ECO Computation Cell&r, making &6C6 &rand &5C9 &ressential for complex, multi-step endgame recipes.

The multiblock is fully modular: you can start with a small structure and expand it by adding more &6Threading Cores&r, &6Parallel Cores&r, and &3Computation Drives &rwith cells to increase parallel jobs and total CPU storage.

The &bECO Computation Cell L4&r, &6ECO Computation Cell L6&r, and &5ECO Computation Cell L9&r are inserted into Computation Drives and provide 64MB, 256MB, and 1GB of crafting CPU storage respectively.
The &aComputation Interface &rconnects the structure to your ME network and exposes the whole cluster as one or more crafting CPUs.
ftbquests.chapter.neo_eco_ae2.quest56.de: The &5x8 High-Energy Network Exchange &ris the endgame mode for the &2ECO Crafting System&r and turns multiple &5F9 &rhosts into one virtual crafting supercomputer.
Use &5x8 virtual exchange &rfor extreme bulk crafting of simple, fast-path recipes where you want to craft millions of items without per-slot limits.
To activate &5x8&r, you need exactly &58 linked F9 crafting hosts &ron the same ME network, connected via &6High-Energy Network Switches&r.
All 8 hosts must share the same &bfrequency channel&r; the mod provides &b16 frequencies&r, and each frequency can support up to 8 crafting multiblocks in one exchange group.
Only when all 8 hosts on one frequency are online and exchange is active does the system switch from normal &5x8 &rbehavior to the special &5virtual exchange &rmode.
In &5virtual exchange&r, eligible fast-path tasks accept the whole requested amount as a single `long` stack, ignoring the normal per-slot batch cap and producing the full output in one go.
Each active virtual task thread consumes a fixed &b10,000 mB &rof the shared coolant pool per tick, independent of item count or batch size.
The shared coolant pool must provide the highest-tier coolant (supporting overclock 9, e.g. &9Cryotheum Solution&r); otherwise the exchange multiplier falls back to &7x1&r.
Power draw is massive: each &5F9 &rhost in &5x8 &rmode draws &6x16 &rpower while exchange is active, so stable high-voltage power is mandatory.
Patterns are pooled across all 8 hosts, and work is fairly distributed to any host with a free slot, making the entire group behave like one giant pattern provider.
ftbquests.chapter.neo_eco_ae2.quest57.de: With network exchange, multiple &5C9 &rhosts on the same frequency can be linked using &6Network Switches &rand &6High-Energy Network Switches&r to form one shared CPU cluster.
In &bx2 &rmode, at least two linked &5C9 &rhosts double the effective threads, accelerators, and CPU storage; in &5x8 &rmode, eight linked &5C9 &rhosts multiply these resources by 8.
The &5high-energy x8 &rmode requires all 8 hosts to use &6High-Energy Network Switches&r and share the same &bfrequency channel&r, turning them into a single logical CPU with massive parallelism.
In ultimate mode, 8 high-energy &5C9 &rhosts with enough Threading Cores and fully filled Computation Drives can reach INT32_MAX parallelism and INT64_MAX bytes of CPU storage.
Use this system when vanilla crafting CPUs reach their limits and you need to run many large, parallel crafting jobs at once.
ftbquests.chapter.neo_eco_ae2.quest58.de: Now that you have gathered enough resources, it's time to move on to the truly powerful part of &2Neo ECO AE Extension&r: &4THE MULTIBLOCKS&r
The terminal shows you the &brequired item counts &r.
In &esurvival mode&r, it builds &astep by step &rover multiple ticks.

Materials are only consumed when a block is &asuccessfully placed&r, and the system can pull items from your &3inventory &ras well as from &3shulker-like containers&r, &3backpacks&r, and other item-handler inventories.
For best results, place the &5controller &rfirst, confirm its &bfacing direction&r, then open the &6Structure Terminal &rto &bpreview &rand &aconstruct &rthe rest of the multiblock around it.
These structures will redefine your ME network with massive storage, extreme crafting speed, and next-level automation.
In the following pages, you will learn how to build and optimize the &2Storage&r, &2Computation&r, and &2Crafting &rmultiblocks to unlock the full potential of your AE2 system.
The &6Structure Terminal &ris a built-in tool in &2Neo ECO AE Extension&r that makes assembling &5large multiblocks &rfast, safe, and almost effortless.
It supports all three main systems: the &2ECO Storage System&r, the &2ECO Computation System&r, and the &2ECO Crafting System&r.
To use it, you must open the &6Structure Terminal&r; inside its GUI you will see the controls for previewing and automatically building the multiblock structures.
In this panel, you can select the &bdesired length &rof the multiblock and see a &bpreview &rof the full structure directly inside the terminal interface.
The preview does &cnot &rappear in the world; everything is shown only within the &6Structure Terminal&r GUI.
Before you can start building, you must have &aall required blocks &rin your inventory or in linked containers; if any block is missing, the auto builder will &cnot start&r.
